name: slides
description: Create, edit, preview, and share Slides.com presentations.

interface.longDescription: Read and inspect existing presentations, build new presentations, revise individual slides, organize a deck, share it with a link, and visually verify the result.
defaultPrompt: Help me create a five-slide presentation from a brief and give me a link I can share.
Draft an email to my team summarizing my latest presentation.
Turn the latest earnings report from Spotify into a five-slide overview.
